_provenance.what: Full production cat turn at 100 ms / 150 ms, both arms, repeated 5x (diagnostic only; the gate is not reproducible so the variance is the deliverable).
_provenance.note: This file is the raw measurement plus this provenance block. No value was edited.

what: Full production cat turn (planHardCatTurn on the real engine) at a fixed 100 ms main-search budget / 150 ms whole-turn wall, both arms, over the 24 frozen human roots. Repeated 5 times because the first two passes disagreed.
whyRepeated: Pass 1 reported plans 22→23, fallback 2→1 and a single changed root (G1T1). Pass 2, identical code and command, reported 23→23, 1→1 and a different changed root (G1T3). A 100 ms cliff cannot be sampled once. Neither sample was discarded; both are kept and 3 more were added.

fragileFindings.note: Which roots change — and whether any changes at all — flips run to run. This gate therefore does NOT support "the optimisation produces better plans"; it only supports "it explores more within the same budget".
